finding: Added SIM / University of London, SIM / University at Buffalo and Murdoch / Kaplan routes. JCU Singapore and Curtin Singapore catalogues were checked; matching Economics/Criminology majors were not confirmed there. Their Australian catalogues are not treated as Singapore availability.
Added Northeastern University London Economics, with 2027 entry published. UK awarding institution and US network origin are shown separately.
Added Bard College Berlin Economics concentration. Lancaster Leipzig catalogue was sampled; Economics modules alone were not counted as an Economics major.

Webster Leiden catalogue was sampled. Its global Economics minor was not confirmed for delivery in Leiden, so no matching foreign-campus route is added on that basis. This does not establish that no other options exist.
Northeastern Toronto was checked and describes graduate programmes. No matching bachelor’s route was confirmed in that sample. Other foreign institutions have not been comprehensively reviewed.

Carnegie Mellon Australia programme pages reviewed describe master’s study. No matching undergraduate Economics/Criminology route was confirmed in that sample. Other overseas providers have not been comprehensively reviewed.
